notes.title: New Enhancements and Release Information
notes.notes:
Good morning!

Release Notice: Bulletproof will be released very soon, at this time we are working on the final details and the good news for you is that Bulletproof has been greatly improved and its entertainment has spread reaching an average value of up to USD$30 but it has been decided that its final and launch price will be USD$10.

I inform you that Bulletproof has received important improvements, the fighting system has received a space limit to avoid crossing the opponents and now Root Motion animations are used to get the character displaced during the animation, the shooting system has also been improved and corrected, due to a problem in the damage system,  it was not receiving major damage and now the Bots can suffer hemorrhages, some details of high level of realism have also been added, in addition new information has been received about the effects of the projectiles so the projectile system has been updated and Secondary (Decorative) Bots have been added to the game modes for a greater impact on the real action of the game,  On the other hand, the problem has been discovered to animate the pelvis so we will proceed to improve the animations of the Panther martial art as soon as possible.

I wish you a great day.
